label: Monado MOC
title: Monado MOC (Samsung Odyssey+)
intro: The MOC calibration recordings of the Monado SLAM Datasets, made with a Samsung Odyssey+ headset: its two tracking cameras and its IMU, 4 camera + IMU recordings.
reading: Chart centre. Each chart is centred on the Monado authors' own Basalt calibration of this headset, made from one recording: extras/calibration.raw.json for the camera–IMU distance, baseline and time offset, and its kb4 version (calibration.kb4.json) for the intrinsics. Their IMU terms are not used: the released recordings appear to carry the authors' IMU correction already, so those charts, and t_ga, are centred on the MVIS median.
no_repeatability: This study has no repeatability cells: they are computed for the leaderboard batch only, and 4 recordings are too few for the test. Each tool's spread is in Parameters by sensor.
study_note: Separate study (batch 2026-11-21): MVIS, Kalibr and Basalt on the 4 MOC camera + IMU recordings, run outside the leaderboard batch, so it has no row here.

families.title: cam0 + cam1 + IMU

solved.poor_why: Poor on 3 of 4 recordings: MOC05 did not converge (reprojection 2.9 px); on MOC08 and MOC11 Kalibr's own camera calibration is wrong (fx about 296–300 px against 269).

families.read_first: Kalibr's intrinsics and baselines are inputs from its own camera-only calibration; its td, lever and IMU intrinsics are solved given them. 3 of its 4 solves are poor (grey note under each Kalibr lane).
notes: Every tool ran on the same 4 recordings, each with its own camera model: MVIS equidistant, Kalibr pinhole-equi and Basalt pinhole-radtan8 (the dataset authors' model, so its intrinsics are shown, not compared).
pinhole-radtan8, the dataset authors' model; its intrinsics are shown, not counted.
